faqs.q: I've lost my Cricbet99 username. How can I find it?
faqs.a: Simply message your account manager on WhatsApp with your registered phone number. They will verify your identity and share your username in seconds.

faqs.q: Why does the site say 'Invalid Login Credentials'?
faqs.a: Check for invisible spaces or case-sensitivity errors. If it still fails, your manager can reset your password privately on WhatsApp for a fresh start.

faqs.q: Is it safe to keep 'Remember Me' turned on?
faqs.a: On your personal, password-locked devices, yes. It saves time during live markets. We recommend logging out on shared or public computers.

faqs.q: Can I recover my account if my phone is lost?
faqs.a: Yes. Connect with us from a new number. Our team will perform a deep security audit to verify your identity and transfer your balance to a new secure ID.
